yt_1: Three or four out of every ten callers **never reach you.**
Not one big failure. **A hundred small ones.**
Rings mid-meeting. Lands while you're on another line. **Someone tries at 6pm.**
You paid to make that phone ring. **A missed call pays for the lead twice.**
Log every missed call for a week. Times your average client. **That's the leak.**
Andy Norman, founder of Antek Automation. **Andover, Hampshire.**
yt_2: Getting found online isn't one job. **It's keeping three bosses happy.**
Boss one: Google's algorithm. **Fast site. Sorted Google Business Profile.**
Boss two: your customers. **The real words they type at 11pm.**
Boss three: your competitors. **You only need to beat them locally.**
Ignore one and rankings slip. **Ignore two and you're invisible.**
Andy Norman, founder of Antek Automation. **Andover, Hampshire.**
yt_3: A full-time receptionist costs **£20,000 to £28,000 a year.**
Plus holiday cover, sick leave **and training on top.**
And most small firms **still miss 30 to 40% of enquiries.**
That's not a staffing problem. **It's a coverage problem.**
A service that catches every caller, **for a fraction of a salary.**
Andy Norman, founder of Antek Automation. **Andover, Hampshire.**
